tables.description: All tables in the configuration, sorted by name

base_chains.description: Base chains (chains with hook declarations), keyed by chain name

named_sets.description: Named sets, keyed by set name

jump_graph.description: Chain-to-chain reference graph. Keys are source chains, values are sorted arrays of target chains referenced via jump or goto

open_tcp_ports.description: TCP destination ports accepted on input-hook chains without source-IP restrictions

open_udp_ports.description: UDP destination ports accepted on input-hook chains without source-IP restrictions

allows_loopback.description: Whether loopback interface traffic is explicitly accepted

allows_icmp.description: Whether ICMP or ICMPv6 traffic is explicitly accepted

uses_connection_tracking.description: Whether connection tracking state matching is used

has_rate_limiting.description: Whether rate limiting is configured in any chain

rate_limited_ports.description: Ports subject to rate limiting, organized as {protocol: {port_string: rate_expression}}. Empty object if no rate limiting.

has_nat.description: Whether network address translation is configured

packet_verdicts.description: Packet fate evaluation results, keyed by test ID from the queries file. Each value is the final verdict after full chain traversal.

anomalies.description: Configuration anomalies detected in the ruleset

unreachable_chains.description: Names of non-base chains that are never referenced by any jump or goto statement in the ruleset

shadowed_rules.description: Rules that can never execute because a preceding rule in the same chain matches unconditionally with a terminal verdict

position.description: 0-based index of the shadowed rule within the chain (excluding the chain type declaration)
